name: element.focus
description: Set keyboard focus on the given element. Subsequent input.keyboard.key / input.keyboard.type calls land in this element.

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`.

x-implementations.name: uia_set_focus
x-implementations.description: UIA `IUIAutomationElement::SetFocus`. Returns ERR not_supported_by_target if the element doesn't accept keyboard focus (e.g. plain Text controls without a TextPattern).

windows-modern.description: SetFocus. Brings the owning window to the foreground if necessary; subject to foreground-lock (returns success regardless — the focus eventually lands when the lock releases). For deterministic foreground placement, call window.focus first.
